title: Omni-Woodpecker: Hallucination Correction via Evidence-Prior Rebalancing for Omni LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.27103v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent Omni LLMs (OLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in joint audio-visual reasoning, yet cross-modal hallucinations remain a major challenge. Existing mitigation methods mainly operate at the output level, overlooking the entanglement of grounding evidence and learned priors within fused representations. To address this issue, we propose Omni-Woodpecker (OWP), a training-free framework that shifts hallucination mitigation from output-level manipulation to conflict-conditioned representation rebalancing. Specifically, OWP first identifies cross-modal conflicts from complementary modality-specific views. It then employs orthogonal decomposition to separate grounding evidence from competing priors within the hidden states. Finally, OWP adaptively rebalances fused representations by suppressing misleading priors and restoring ignored evidence before decoding. translated_title: Omni-Woodpecker：通过证据-先验再平衡修正全模态大语言模型的幻觉
translated_abstract: 近期的全模态大语言模型（OLLMs）在音视频联合推理方面展现出卓越的能力，但跨模态幻觉仍然是一个重大挑战。现有的缓解方法主要在输出层面进行操作，忽视了融合表示中接地证据与学习先验之间的纠缠问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 Omni-Woodpecker（OWP），这是一个无需训练的框架，将幻觉缓解从输出层面的操作转变为基于冲突条件的表示再平衡。具体而言，OWP 首先从互补的模态特定视角识别跨模态冲突；然后采用正交分解将隐藏状态中的接地证据与竞争性先验分离开来；最后，OWP 在解码前通过抑制误导性先验并恢复被忽视的证据，自适应地再平衡融合表示。大量实验证明了该方法的有效性和强大的跨……
tldr: 提出了无需训练的 Omni-Woodpecker 框架，通过识别跨模态冲突、正交分解分离接地证据与学习先验，并在解码前自适应地再平衡融合表示，从而有效修正全模态大语言模型的跨模态幻觉。
en_tdlr: Omni-Woodpecker is a training-free framework that corrects cross-modal hallucinations in Omni LLMs by identifying cross-modal conflicts, orthogonally decomposing hidden states to separate grounding evidence from competing priors, and adaptively rebalancing fused representations before decoding.
